Initial processing of loaded data. Please select whether MBR has been switched on during the data processing in DIA-NN and you are starting with the main report after the search against the project specific library generated during the search, or whether the MBR was switched off or you are using first-pass report from the search where the MBR was switched on. This will adjust the columns to be filtered the report on.%%00010%%00010Monitored modification form field enables you to get peptide level table pivotted on the level of unique peptide + set of monitored modifications level. Modifications not set as monitored are ignored and peptides modified by any not monitored modification are combined with the not modified peptide counterparts accordingly (see below). For each monitored modification, the extra column is returned with the number of modifications observed in each row of the resulting table of modified peptides.%%00010%%00010The metanode requires you to provide the main report from DIA-NN and also two extra experimental design related tables - please see the Experimental_design.xlsx file in the __input__ subfolder inside the KNIME workflow.%%00010%%00010Data preprocessing covers the following steps. First, lower quality peptides are filtered out based on the form fields settings (q or PEP thresholds set). Next, precursors are pivotted on the stripped sequence level or modified peptide sequence level and further grouped to get to the protein group (PG) level (using stripped peptide level table only) using maximum values for all intensity columns and minimal values for all types of q-values. The total quantity sum is calculated for every PG and peptide from all samples used later on for sorting.%%00010%%00010The last output of this metanode is experimental design covering the individual run and associated sample names, batch factors and sample groups specifications.
